## CreateHooksFn type

Represents the function used to define hooks and related configuration.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type CreateHooksFn<CSSProperties, CSSPropertyConflicts extends object = object> = <const Hooks extends Hook[]>(...hooks: Hooks) => CreateHooksResult<Hooks, CSSProperties, CSSPropertyConflicts>;
```
**References:** [Hook](./core.hook.md)<!-- -->, [CreateHooksResult](./core.createhooksresult.md)

## Remarks

When the registered hooks are known to include one or more `flag:<name>` values, the return type also exposes `enable()` and `disable()` functions restricted to their short names.
